name: Have I Been Pwned
measures: Verified data breaches and accounts exposed
about: Have I Been Pwned collects data breaches and lets people check whether they were affected. We count verified breaches from its public list, without fabricated breaches or spam lists, and publish no account data.
limitations: It only includes breaches that surfaced and were loaded, so it undercounts.
We count by the date a breach was added, which can be years after it happened.
A single huge breach can dominate the yearly account total.
attribution: Breach data from Have I Been Pwned (haveibeenpwned.com). We count verified breaches and publish the results.
